special_notes: The object is a caster-wheeled trolley. Each wheel assembly has two degrees of freedom: a swivel joint (continuous, Z-axis) for the entire wheel Xform, and a roll joint (continuous, local X-axis) for the tire. Each wheel also has a brake lever which should lock the roll and/or swivel motion when engaged.
